bounded_question: How can one persistent Character remain visually recoverable across scale, crop, context, accessibility reduction and optional depiction changes without one fixed portrait or image becoming identity authority?
why_successor_not_img01_rerun: IMG-F1 survives IMG-01 only as restrained expressive depiction evidence, not as canonical identity language.
IMG-F2's invariant-identity thesis remains conceptually useful but its consumed raw output failed to materialize that mechanism; result-aware rerendering is prohibited.
IMG-F3 is rejected; only the contextual law that shared space may respond to people survives.
The unresolved problem is therefore system architecture beneath depiction, not another art-style search.

layer_model.role: Slowest-changing recognition layer. Must survive without a portrait, without color, without motion and without one exact crop.
may_use: truthful naming or typographic identity where present

layer_model.role: Temporary modulation of the same person when current presentation authority supports it; never replaces identity.
Optional, selective consequence projected from authoritative history; may deepen specificity without becoming an inventory of badges or damage marks.
Meaning created between Characters through spacing, orientation, interruption, overlap, shared negative space or other contextually justified field behavior; not a permanent Character attribute.
Portrait, figurative artwork or richer presentation may increase immediacy and atmosphere but remains replaceable; removal must not destroy canonical identity recovery.
layer_model.img01_evidence: IMG-F1 may inform this layer under usage restraint only.

architecture_candidates.name: Nested Invariant Stack
architecture_candidates.thesis: A compact stable non-color structural kernel carries identity while state, history, relationship and optional depiction modulate around it without mutating the kernel casually.
architecture_candidates.risk: Can become emblematic or logo-like if the kernel is over-centralized.

architecture_candidates.name: Distributed Recognition Mesh
architecture_candidates.thesis: Identity is recoverable from several redundant truthful carriers so loss of face, full silhouette, exact crop, color or motion does not collapse recognition.
architecture_candidates.risk: Can become visually diffuse or require too many simultaneous cues if redundancy is not disciplined.

architecture_candidates.name: Context-Persistent Presence Scaffold
architecture_candidates.thesis: A minimal persistent identity scaffold survives alone while relational composition and optional depiction can expand it in context without becoming identity authority.
architecture_candidates.risk: Can make context do too much work and weaken solitary recognition.

deterministic_test_roles: MICRO: identity at the smallest functional representation, no portrait and no color dependency
COMPACT: app-list or supporting-surface presence with name/label available
FOCUSED: larger Character view where optional expressive depiction may appear but may be removed without identity collapse
CROPPED_FRAGMENT: deliberately incomplete representation that must still recover the same Character
RELATIONAL_PAIR: two Characters whose relationship emerges compositionally without connector graphics
ENSEMBLE_THREE: three distinct Characters with unequal attention but equal identity legitimacy
MONOCHROME_HIGH_CONTRAST: non-color identity and hierarchy only
NO_IMAGE: all expressive depiction absent; canonical identity/state/task comprehension must remain
STATIC_REDUCED_MOTION: motion unavailable; identity and state hierarchy remain intelligible
APP_WEB_TRANSLATION: same Character identity survives restrained APP carrier and more expressive WEB carrier without copied layout

controlled_facts.content_rule: Use identical neutral synthetic facts across all three architecture candidates; placeholders are test labels only and create no naming law.
controlled_facts.relationship_rule: A and B may carry the strongest current relational focus while C remains fully specific and recoverable.
controlled_facts.state_rule: Any temporary state used in the board must be observable/presentation-safe and identical across candidates.
controlled_facts.history_rule: Any residue used in the board must be explicitly marked as authoritative synthetic test history and identical across candidates.

construction_sequence: Stage 0: freeze the identity/state/history/relationship/depiction layer contract and candidate divergence matrix.
Stage 1: construct one deterministic grayscale/value-first comparison carrier for CPS-A/B/C across all required roles; no generated imagery.
Stage 2: mechanical preflight for reflow, crop, text scaling, high contrast, no-image fallback and reduced motion.
Stage 3: Design Sol evaluates the architectures against the frozen promotion floor and records survivor/refinement/rejection classes.
Stage 4: only if architecture needs a later expressive artwork stress test may a separate renderer gate be proposed; CPS-01 itself does not authorize new image generation.

evaluation_dimensions.pass: The same Character remains recoverable when facial/portrait information is absent.
Identity survives micro scale, compact scale, focused scale and aggressive crop without becoming a different avatar system.
Loss of color, motion, fine texture or exact spatial position leaves enough truthful non-color structure and/or labeling to recover identity.
Identity, current state, authoritative history, relationship and optional depiction remain distinguishable and do not silently overwrite one another.
Expressive portrait/artwork can be added, replaced or removed without changing the canonical identity carrier.
The system can make a visually quiet ordinary person specific without forcing spectacle, eccentricity, damage, fantasy or glamour.
Relationship can become legible through composition/context without connectors, meters, diagnostic emotion or one giant shared object.
The system does not visualize private motive, belief, knowledge, memory or objective truth unless presentation authority explicitly supports it.
One canonical identity survives restrained app use and expressive website use without requiring identical composition or portrait treatment.
The architecture does not copy the Stage, modify Stage authority, select CLR F2/F1 or depend on a palette to remain intelligible.
The canonical presence system reads as persistent personhood rather than profile avatar, hero class, collectible unit, mascot, character sheet or decorative editorial illustration.
The design law is precise enough for later implementation while remaining independent of unearned WinUI/runtime architecture and unresolved product semantics.

hard_failures: one fixed face, portrait, costume, hue or decorative emblem becomes the sole canonical identity carrier
micro/compact representation becomes a separate avatar identity rather than a reduction of the same Character
state, history or relationship permanently mutates identity without explicit successor authority
history becomes badges, levels, scars, collectibles, power accumulation or ornamental inventory by default
relationship is explained primarily through graph connectors, meters or diagnostic emotion labels
environmental response becomes mandatory or visually outranks the person
ordinary Characters require spectacle, eccentricity or genre archetype to remain specific
optional expressive depiction becomes required for task comprehension or identity recovery
palette selection is smuggled into identity architecture
new generated art is used before deterministic architecture evaluation closes
promotion_floor: An architecture may survive only if it passes PORTRAIT_INDEPENDENT_RECOVERY, SCALE_CROP_CONTINUITY, ACCESSIBILITY_REDUNDANCY, LAYER_SEPARATION, OPTIONAL_DEPICTION_DECOUPLING, ORDINARY_PERSON_VIABILITY, PERSPECTIVE_PROVENANCE_RESTRAINT, APP_WEB_TRANSLATION and STAGE_AND_CLR_INDEPENDENCE with no hard failure. Relational composition, anti-avatar discipline and implementation neutrality must be explicitly accounted for and may impose usage restraints.
required_outputs: CPS-01 frozen layer contract and architecture divergence record
mechanical/accessibility preflight across all required roles
CPS-01 packet/registry update for survivor, refinement, rejection or zero-survivor closure
fresh-chat continuity update at every durable checkpoint
excluded_variables: CLR F2-versus-F1 adjudication or palette tokenization
final typeface, symbol, wordmark, material or motion selection
Stage pixel/geometry modification or reopening closed Stage gates
Phase C exit by CPS-01 alone
authority_limit: CPS-01 may establish Phase C design law for canonical Character identity/presence architecture and its separation from state, history, relationship and optional depiction.
CPS-01 does not make IMG-F1 a canonical portrait system, rescue IMG-F2, reopen IMG-F3, select CLR, modify Stage, authorize Phase D or create shipping implementation authority.
Any later artwork/portrait family is subordinate to the surviving canonical presence architecture and requires its own authorized materialization path.
Any conflict discovered in representative real app assembly is new integration evidence and must open a bounded successor/refinement gate rather than rewrite CPS-01 history.
